summary: Iteration 5 validated the documentation-push readiness. TESTING.md sections 1, 2, 5, 6 executed literally; web regression spot-check (section 7) and backend REST regression all pass. Docs present and coherent: /app/README.md (monorepo), /app/ai-context-tracker/{README.md, ROADMAP.md, TESTING.md, CHANGELOG.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, LICENSE}. Both workflow locations exist: /app/.github/workflows/{ci.yml, publish.yml} (with `working-directory: ai-context-tracker`) and /app/ai-context-tracker/.github/workflows/{ci.yml, publish.yml}; all 4 YAMLs parse cleanly with PyYAML. Pytest: 31 passed in 0.34s. REPL flow (section 2) with ACT_STATE_DIR=/tmp/act-test: get_status shows [AWARENESS] header + JSON; update_task recorded; record_usage(50k,8k) then (90k,12k) fired WARNING (30%) and DANGER (20%); record_usage(30k,5k) fired RED ALERT (97.5% used, 2.5% left) and auto-saved handoff ('An automatic handoff summary was saved (danger threshold reached).'); count_tokens returned 'count: 300 tokens'; create_handoff saved for session; get_model_info('gpt-5.1') showed '400,000 context | 128,000 max output'. Crash-sim in a fresh interpreter (srv._tracker=None) produced 'Previous session detected: ee784be2bb42 ... call resume_session'; resume_session RESUMED with task, summary, and handoff intact. /tmp/act-test cleaned. Section 5: `ai-context-tracker sessions` listed the 3 seeded sessions (3aacc4b13b92 claude latest, 0b15287ef875 gemini, b98b6f902048 gpt-5.1); `--help` showed serve/dashboard/sessions/init; `init` wrote a valid config.yaml in /tmp/act-init. Python feed snippet ran cleanly and bumped 3aacc4b13b92 to turn 8 (acceptable per note). Section 6 without keys: AnthropicProvider().count_tokens returned estimate=2 (no crash); OpenAIProvider().get_org_usage returned {'error': 'OPENAI_ADMIN_KEY not set — org-level usage requires an Admin API key'}. Backend REST: GET /api/tracker/sessions -> 200 with keys {sessions, latest_session_id} (3 sessions, latest=3aacc4b13b92); GET /api/tracker/config -> 200 with alert_thresholds/red_alert_threshold/danger_threshold/auto_handoff/timezone/provider/model/features/config_path. Web dashboard (Playwright, domcontentloaded): sidebar shows 3 sessions, LIVE badge on latest; context-gauge, burn-rate-chart, rate-limit-watch, compare-toggle-btn, org-fetch-btn, settings-open-btn, handoff-0 all present. handoff-0 opens handoff-dialog; settings-open-btn opens role=dialog; compare-toggle-btn toggles compare-view; org-fetch-btn (anthropic default) returns 'ANTHROPIC_ADMIN_KEY not set — org-level usage requires an Admin API key' in org-usage-result. No console errors of significance (1 hydration warning: <span> as child of <option> in select — minor cosmetic, non-blocking).

issues: Console hydration warning: a <span> is being rendered as a child of <option>. Native <option> elements cannot contain <span>. Wrap label text as plain string inside <option>.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Remove <span> inside <option> in the org provider <select> to silence the React hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Duplicate workflow files exist in both /app/.github/workflows/ and /app/ai-context-tracker/.github/workflows/. Root workflows use `working-directory: ai-context-tracker`; nested ones do not (they assume the package folder is the repo root). This is intentional per the monorepo README, but if the user publishes both places it will cause double CI runs. Consider documenting which path to keep depending on how they publish.

TESTING.md section 5 python feed will always bump the currently-latest seeded session by one turn on every read-through — as noted this is acceptable, but a paragraph could clarify that the demo state can be re-seeded via `python scripts/seed_demo.py` to reset it.
Native HTML <option> element rendering a child <span> triggers a React hydration warning — small but noisy in production console.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth. Section 6 explicitly tests the no-keys path.
